class.name: IfcStructuralLoadStatic
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: The abstract entity IfcStructuralLoadStatic is the supertype of all static loads (actions or reactions) which can be defined. Within scope are single i.e. concentrated forces and moments, linear i.e. one-dimensionally distributed forces and moments, planar i.e. two-dimensionally distributed forces, furthermore displacements and temperature loads. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2
